glosses: An artificial intelligence program that generates a nude picture of a person, given a clothed picture.

examples.text: The so-called nudifier apps are simple and cheap for anyone to use, with some even offering free trials. I took a look at some of them. These apps are being widely used by students in schools, and for victims, having artificially generated nudes of them out in the wild has been as traumatizing as it would be if the photos were real. Though a new federal law makes it a crime to post nonconsensual fake nudes online, there’s nothing stopping people from using the nudifier apps, which have proliferated on the web. Dozens of the nudifier sites are raking in millions of dollars a year.
Photos and links from this new, so far unrivaled “nudifier” have spread across Twitter, Facebook, Reddit, Telegram and other major platforms, in private and public channels alike.
The platform in question is DeepSukebe, which describes itself as an "AI-leveraged nudifier" to "make all men's dreams come true."
